WITH it1 AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'countries'
),
it2 AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'rating'
),
k AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM keyword
    WHERE keyword IN ('murder', 'murder-in-title', 'blood', 'violence')
),
cn AS (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM company_name
    WHERE country_code != '[us]'
),
filtered_mc AS (
    SELECT movie_id, company_id, company_type_id
    FROM movie_companies
    WHERE note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%'
      AND note LIKE '%(200%)%'
),
filtered_title AS (
    SELECT id, title, kind_id
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year > 2008
)
SELECT
    (
        SELECT MIN(cn.name)
        FROM cn
        JOIN filtered_mc AS mc ON mc.company_id = cn.id
        JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
        JOIN filtered_title AS t ON t.id = mc.movie_id
        JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
        WHERE kt.kind IN ('movie', 'episode')
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM k
              JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
              WHERE mk.movie_id = t.id
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM it1
              JOIN movie_info AS mi ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
              WHERE mi.movie_id = t.id
                AND mi.info IN ('Germany', 'German', 'USA', 'American')
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM it2
              JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
              WHERE mi_idx.movie_id = t.id
                AND mi_idx.info < '7.0'
          )
    ) AS movie_company,
    (
        SELECT MIN(mi_idx.info)
        FROM it2
        JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
        JOIN filtered_title AS t ON t.id = mi_idx.movie_id
        JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
        WHERE kt.kind IN ('movie', 'episode')
          AND mi_idx.info < '7.0'
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM k
              JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
              WHERE mk.movie_id = t.id
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM it1
              JOIN movie_info AS mi ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
              WHERE mi.movie_id = t.id
                AND mi.info IN ('Germany', 'German', 'USA', 'American')
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM filtered_mc AS mc
              JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
              JOIN cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
              WHERE mc.movie_id = t.id
          )
    ) AS rating,
    (
        SELECT MIN(t.title)
        FROM filtered_title AS t
        JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
        WHERE kt.kind IN ('movie', 'episode')
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM k
              JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
              WHERE mk.movie_id = t.id
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM it1
              JOIN movie_info AS mi ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
              WHERE mi.movie_id = t.id
                AND mi.info IN ('Germany', 'German', 'USA', 'American')
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM it2
              JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
              WHERE mi_idx.movie_id = t.id
                AND mi_idx.info < '7.0'
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM filtered_mc AS mc
              JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
              JOIN cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
              WHERE mc.movie_id = t.id
          )
    ) AS western_violent_movie
